title: rattlesnake pulse fast
intent: Use a clipped real rattlesnake burst as a fast pickup before the backbeat.

evidence.use: Use the measured noisy burst evidence to choose an audible source slice; do not claim animal intent.
Choose a call-bearing region from the measured attacks before fitting it to the authored grid.

operations.intent: Chop one measured rattle burst into a short pickup.
Speed the pickup into the gap before the backbeat without changing pitch.
Keep this real source hit above the kick and bass.
Keep the actual field source audible without making the pickup dominate.
Remove the edited slice seam before grid placement.
Close the fast pickup without a click.
